d: Touring the infamous Pauly Jail in Union Springs, Alabama, where Shane once had a life-changing experience  listen as chilling voices echo through the abandoned cells and spirits desperate to share.
Exploring the legend of Matilda Sorrel and her ties to the historic Sorrel-Weed House in Savannah, Georgia  getting chills when Shane, Dave, and Cindy visit this former estate and discover things.
Visit a shrine where all faiths converge, then stand back as the team discovers a tear in its spiritual shield  witness a ritual  watch hidden secrets surface.
Strolling down the corridors of the Old Hospital on College Hill in Williamson, West Virginia  exploring reports of childlike laughter echoing through the building, then try to find an explanation.

Campus police officers find a male student whose head has been smashed into his steering wheel and a female cowering nearby  a firefighter arrives on the scene of a car crash, only to realize that the car passed him a few minutes earlier.

st: Basement Dweller, Do Not Resuscitate and Children of the Barn
d: A dark entity attacks a security guard in the basement of a nursing home  an EMT has a chilling encounter with a dying man  a paramedic hears ghostly children playing in an old barn.

st: Home Intruder, Fire Woman and Dead Man's Curve
d: A rookie EMT gets an unwanted guest, a haunting lullaby lures firefighters inside a burning building  a paramedic encounters a terrifying apparition on a remote road.

st: Scarred, War House Haunting and Winged Demon
d: EMT Rob Thompson pulls a man from a flaming wreck who is near death  police officer Vicki Schramm investigates an armed man breaking into an abandoned home  paramedic Jackie Williams assists a man who appears to be in serious psychosis.
